_doc: Stage 1 pre-generation prompt-risk parameters. knowledge_cutoff_year: a year strictly greater than this in the prompt is treated as post-cutoff (the model cannot know it) => higher time risk; set to the deployed model's training cutoff. relative_markers: phrases whose presence indicates time-relative questions whose answer drifts. Weights for combining s1..s4 live in config/weights.json -> prompt_risk.
